migration.title: Migrate project workbench

migration.confirm: Copy the readable originals, preserve unavailable markers, and make the old workbench read-only with the history boundary described above.

migration.done: Review migration and source project save completed.
migration.readonly: This project workbench was migrated. The old content below is a read-only backup; continue review and rework in the independent node.
migration.oldVersion: Older apps may still change the source backup and cannot read independent nodes. Preview again to detect source changes and explicitly import them as new batches. No automatic overwrite or reverse synchronization occurs.

purge.title: Permanently delete task
purge.description: Permanently removes this node, all retained versions, feedback, handoffs, steps and undo history. This cannot be undone. Back up the node first if you need these records.

backup.title: Back up all nodes

visual.title: Guide me visually
visual.description: When I dislike the overall direction or cannot describe my preferences, offer a few distinct key frames or short motion prototypes. Let me compare one design question at a time before expanding production.

explain.title: Explain through visual changes
explain.description: Use the creation, connection, transformation and comparison of graphics to explain ideas. Use text for labels and emphasis; avoid relying mainly on successive static title cards.

sample.title: Try a short segment first
sample.description: For changes to overall style, structure or motion language, produce a representative short segment for direction review before expanding production.

compare.title: Offer comparable alternatives
compare.description: Offer a few alternatives for the same content, describe their main differences and focus each round on one design question. Let me express preferences by choosing and pointing.

preserve.title: Preserve what I approved
preserve.description: Keep approved design choices in subsequent edits and limit the scope of changes. Explain the reason and impact before changing an approved part.

review.title: Review inside the project
review.description: Locate and preview edits on the current timeline. Export the whole video only when I request file delivery. Rendering intermediate animation assets is still allowed.

resources.title: Check existing assets and methods
resources.description: Check relevant project assets and the personal library when planning. Reuse suitable resources and methods, and verify tool availability rather than assuming library notes prove it.

tool.title: Prefer a specific tool
tool.description: For 【purpose, such as concept images】, prefer 【tool, such as local Moss-Image】. Check availability first. Explain when it is unavailable or unsuitable and propose an alternative.

skill.title: Use a specific animation skill
skill.description: For code animation, use 【skill name or path】. Reference 【asset and range, plus the qualities to borrow】 for visual direction. The skill handles implementation; the reference informs design.
